final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Ospedali, cliniche, case di cura e assimilabili'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 1600
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the building located near healthcare services. Per the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), the threshold is rounded to 75 to represent a strong proximity requirement. Hotel typology, floor area, capacity, and energy class are building attributes and are excluded.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 1600. The 30-resident capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied. Energy class and proximity to healthcare are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents. Turin is a city name, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set.
The user prefers an energy class of D or better, so buildings from A1 to D are included.
